title: spec(ui): an action:button component accepts confirmText beside an array params, the two-dialog pair ActionSchema and InlineActionSchema refuse
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Ruled: 6597621758 · letter A
Ruling-ref: 6597621758

Filing gate: ② a decision the maintainer made. In the project thread "Discuss pending spec rulings", the maintainer answered 「同意」 at 2026-11-03T07:05:46Z to an A (refuse) / B (keep) question that recommended A. The question came from the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review of PR #29829 (#29383), record 6597260383, which found this third door outside ruling A on #29383. The ruling text is recorded as this card's first comment. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (same as #29383).

**Business reason.** A page's `action:button` that carries both `confirmText` and an array `params` shows the user a confirm dialog first and a param dialog second, two dialogs for one decision. After #29829, the registered door (`ActionSchema`) and the inline door (`InlineActionSchema`) both refuse that pair, but `action:button` would still accept it. Reader: the `domain:spec` seat (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`).

## What the code does

`ActionButtonPropsSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` ≈:3947 on `origin/main`) carries `confirmText`, `description` (the param dialog shows it under its title) and `params: z.unknown()`. An array `params` is the list of inputs to collect and is forwarded to the same `ActionRunner` as `actionParams`, so the runner awaits the confirm and then opens the param dialog. An object `params` is static values and opens no dialog. The schema has no pair rule.

## Wanted (ruling A)

- `ActionButtonPropsSchema` refuses `confirmText` beside a non-empty ARRAY `params`, at path `['confirmText']`, with the same predicate and message family `ActionSchema` and `InlineActionSchema` use (reuse `CONFIRM_BESIDE_PARAMS_REFUSAL` / `declaresConfirmBesideParams` from `action.zod.ts` after #29829, or its equivalent).
- Still accepted: `confirmText` with no `params`, beside `params: []`, and beside an object-form `params`.
- Census of in-repo `action:button` carriers with both keys before building: `examples/`, `packages/**`, `ui/**`, `skills/**`, templates, cloud fixtures. A coarse grep found only test fixtures.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` · `@objectstack/spec` minor, with the ADR-0087 disposition (precedent: #29829's `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker).

Serial: after PR #29829 (which moves the shared refusal to module level). One S PR, not a widening of #29829.

Dedupe: searched `ActionButtonProps confirmText params`, `action:button confirmText params refuse`: only #29383 (the inline door) and its PR #29829. **New.**
